description: CTE scoping and the PR #16 fail-closed bypasses (spec 001 §6.1): nothing may hide inside a CTE, a nested query, a set operation, a recursive term or a PIVOT, and CTE names shadow only within their lexical scope.

setup: CREATE TABLE mine (a BIGINT, b VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE sluice_calls (a BIGINT, scope_id VARCHAR, flat_tables VARCHAR[])
CREATE VIEW sluice_calls__0123 AS SELECT * FROM sluice_calls

cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM x
WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM sqlite_master) SELECT * FROM x
WITH x AS (WITH y AS (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM y) SELECT * FROM x
WITH x AS (SELECT 1), y AS (SELECT * FROM x, sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM y
SELECT * FROM (WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM x) s
SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM x)
SELECT a FROM mine UNION ALL (WITH x AS (SELECT a FROM sluice_calls) SELECT a FROM x)
WITH x AS (SELECT a FROM mine UNION ALL SELECT a FROM sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM x
WITH RECURSIVE r AS (SELECT a FROM sluice_calls UNION ALL SELECT a FROM r) SELECT * FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r AS (SELECT a FROM mine UNION ALL SELECT s.a FROM r, sluice_calls s) SELECT * FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 FROM sluice_calls UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r) SELECT * FROM r
SELECT * FROM (PIVOT sluice_calls ON a IN (1) USING count(*))
SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 1) a JOIN sluice_calls b ON true
SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT a FROM sluice_calls
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls) s
SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls)
WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM range(100000000000)) SELECT count(*) FROM x
WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM duckdb_tables()) SELECT * FROM x
WITH x AS (SELECT sleep_ms(1)) SELECT * FROM x
WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM main.mine) SELECT * FROM x
WITH sluice_calls AS (SELECT * FROM sluice_calls) SELECT * FROM sluice_calls
cases.description: CTE names are honoured by lexical scope and declaration order; collecting them globally is a complete bypass.

cases.note: DuckDB 2.0.1 and 1.5.5 resolve the reference to the physical table, not to the CTE, because U+017F only casefolds to 's'. A gate that folds Unicode case admits the statement and reads every scope's envelope.
